releases.title: 成員與權限：平台管理員與工作區管理員可以多位（最後一位受保護）、專案管理員／專案成員／唯讀成員、專案可見度（開放／審核／私人）、成員名冊、工作區設定與平台設定分開、移出工作區（含自己離開）與停用帳號分開、已有帳號的人要先登入才能接受邀請回來；升級時同時是 leader 又是唯讀的人先當唯讀成員，在成員名冊標給工作區管理員確認；管理用 API 有變更（見 API 參考 3.20） · Members & access: several platform and workspace admins (the last one protected), project admins / members / viewers, project visibility (open / approval / private), a member directory, separate workspace and platform settings, removing someone from the workspace (or leaving it) separate from disabling their account, existing accounts sign in to accept an invitation back; on upgrade, someone who was both leader and read-only stays a viewer and is flagged in the member directory for workspace admins; admin API changes (see API reference 3.20)
